decisionsTitle: «Kituri de pregătit» writes its total as a sum: «N = X alergători + Y voluntari»
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-04,** of «Kituri de pregătit: 190 — 179 de alergători + 11 voluntari»: «trebuie să fie „Kituri de pregătit: 190 = 179 de alergători + 11 voluntari”».

**Decision.** The title with volunteers says its total as a sum, with «=» where the dash was (`Admin.registrations.kits.titleWithVolunteers`, RO and EN); the counts and their forms are unchanged.
changelogLine: - **«Kituri de pregătit: 190 = 179 de alergători + 11 voluntari»** — the total written as a sum. §NNN.
batchLine: the kits' total written as a sum
